reply.text: Tight back is worth a look from someone who can examine you, so if it feels sharp, numb, or is getting worse, that one is for a doctor or physio, not a coach. If it's just general tightness, I can build around it, and I'll need to know what to avoid. Tell me what hurts when you lift and what's off-limits, and I'll put an upper session together for you. The app puts a Build it button under this reply once we've settled the details.
